AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

EnterpriseId.description: Unique identifier of the enterprise. Required when using [Portfolio Access Tokens](https://mews-systems.gitbook.io/connector-api/concepts/multi-property), ignored otherwise.

BillingAutomationId.description: Unique identifier of the `Billing automation` associated with the payment plan.

CustomerId.description: Unique identifier of the `Customer` associated with the payment plan.

PaymentRequest.title: Billing automation payment plan payment request
PaymentRequest.description: Data related to the payment request associated with the payment plan created.

PaymentOffsetDays.description: Number of days since the bill creation when the payment will be charged.

StartMonth.description: Specifies the month when the payment plan begins collecting payments, in the 'YYYY-MM' format. The month must be in the future. If a value is not set, it'll start with the earliest available bill created from billing automation.
